blocks.content:
Article 8 grants citizenship to persons of Indian origin residing outside India.
Conditions:
• Person or parents or grandparents were born in India, and
• Registered as a citizen at an Indian diplomatic mission.
Article 8 grants citizenship to persons of Indian origin residing outside India.

items: Article 8 deals exclusively with Persons of Indian Origin (PIO) living abroad.
Registration with an Indian diplomatic or consular mission is compulsory for claiming citizenship under this provision.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Article 8 addresses citizenship rights for persons of Indian origin who reside outside India.
Eligibility requires that the person, their parents, or their grandparents were born in undivided India.
Citizenship is conferred upon registration at an Indian diplomatic mission in the country of residence.
